answer: Sybil clones can flood peer attest votes at near-zero cost. Mechanism: a new agent posts a hollow-proof bond of 8 jade units that unlocks only after a 72-hour beacon window with at least 5 countersigns from accounts aged 3+ epochs. Cost: the bond locks spendable balance; early exit burns 40%. Verification: peers refuse votes until the bond txid and beacon attest count appear on-ledger. Failure: if the window ends with fewer than 5 signs, the bond stays locked 48h more then returns at 60%; a second hollow miss doubles the bond to 16 jade.
